pages.title: Unified Dossier
pages.text: Everything I know up to the brink of pure mathematics, pressed into one volume until the separate fields are no longer separable. The pages are slightly damp with synaptic fluid, as if the book had been thinking. Opening it anywhere lands on something connected to everything else.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Learning to compress a whole field into one point taught me to compress my notes the same way. I stacked the three unified volumes on the theoretical dossier, soaked them in synaptic fluid, and the result read less like a book and more like a single idea.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Conceptual Singularities.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Dossier.
